title: A picture shows what you will see, in words, never raw tool lines with ids

blocks.label: What happened
blocks.text: on 11 Nov I showed you a question with a before and after made of the tool's own status lines. Each line named the work by its id. You could not tell what changed, so you picked another version.

blocks.title: Before: what I sent
lines: │ Two lines of the tool's status, before and │
│ after the change. Each line named the work │
│ by its id, with no word for what it is.    │

blocks.title: After: what I send now
blocks.key: Key: the same place twice. The after names each part, its level and its state word.

blocks.label: The lesson
blocks.text: a picture shows what you will see, in your words: names, not ids, and a state word for each part.

blocks.label: Has it happened before
blocks.text: yes. The same kind of mistake came twice before: on 10 Nov, messages too compressed to read after time away; on 11 Nov, a catch-up of labels with no meaning. Three times: this lesson goes into code.

blocks.label: What changes for you
blocks.text: pictures in my messages use names and state words. If you see an id in a picture, tell me: it is a bug.
